geneformer.tokenizer_or_gene_vocab: geneformer.TranscriptomeTokenizer rank-value encoding; token_dictionary.pkl (Ensembl ID -> token), gene_median_dictionary.pkl
geneformer.gene_vocabulary: geneformer.TranscriptomeTokenizer rank-value encoding; token_dictionary.pkl (Ensembl ID -> token), gene_median_dictionary.pkl
geneformer.preprocessing: Rank-value encoding per cell: counts normalized by each gene's non-zero median expression across Genecorpus, ranked, truncated to model input size. Requires raw counts in adata.X, Ensembl IDs in adata.var['ensembl_id'], and per-cell total counts in adata.obs['n_counts']. Performed by the official TranscriptomeTokenizer.
geneformer.pooling_or_cell_embedding_method: CLS-token embedding (emb_mode='cls'): cell embedding read from the <cls> token prepended to the rank-value encoding
geneformer.source_inspected: geneformer.EmbExtractor (emb_mode='cls', cell_emb_style='mean_pool', emb_layer=-1, model_version='V2').extract_embs(...) and geneformer.TranscriptomeTokenizer; https://geneformer.readthedocs.io/en/latest/geneformer.emb_extractor.html
